lightning.title: Purple lightning (rework, jointed rig): cast, a 2 s storm of 14 strikes, recover

keys.caption: Idle key 0: hovering, staff across the body in both hands, tails loose, legs hang
Anticipation: staff drawn back and up over her right shoulder, body coils right and dips, knees tuck; tails still swing the old way
Cast raise, overshoot: staff thrust up past the top on a straight arm, chest arched, left arm flung out; bright point and cross flare at the tip
Settle: staff back upright, she sinks a little, left hand braced out; the charge crackles at the point; tails fling up and out
Brace (Dodge bar ends): turns side-on, staff levelled at the arena in both hands, leans into it, legs split; hair and tails blown back
HIT, strike 1 of 14: the arena flashes white; lightning bursts from the tip, the recoil kicks her back and tips the staff up; tails snap back
Strike 5: she drives back against the recoil, staff tracks left across the room, weight forward; tails whip to her right
Strike 10: hips swing the staff back across to her right, low and level, torso twisted against it; tails whip the other way
Release (strikes end): she throws the staff up and away, body uncoils and floats up, legs swing through; last sparks; tails fly forward
Recover = idle key 0: staff back across the body in both hands, settled
Idle key 0: hovering, staff across the body in both hands, tails loose, legs hang
Breath in: chest lifts, sway starts to her left, left leg swings back
Chest up, head turns right to scan the room; tails lag, still swinging in
Breath out: shoulders drop, staff tips down a little, legs pass each other
Sway at its left; tails catch up and flick out, the wave running to the tips
Weight back to the middle, staff level again, left leg forward
Breath in again: sway starts to her right, head turns left
Sway at its right, right leg swings back; tails trail, swinging out
Breath out: chest settles, the staff rocks back up
Coming home: tails settle last, a beat behind the body (loops to key 1)

watch.title: Watch: hover while the Stone Golem stands (rework, jointed rig)

keys.caption: Watch key 0: calm hover, staff held low, eyes on the golem at her right
Breath in, she leans toward it a little; tails lag
Head follows the golem's arms, chin up
Breath out, staff tips down; legs pass each other
Sway to her left; tails flick out a beat later
Back to the middle, eyes back on the golem
Breath in, sway to her right
Head turns further after it; right leg swings back
Breath out, staff rocks up
Settling: tails come home last (loops to key 1)

barrage.title: Barrage (rework, jointed rig): circles open in front of the staff, a 2 s storm of beams, recover

keys.caption: Idle key 0: hovering, staff across the body in both hands
Anticipation: staff swung back and low past her right hip, body coils right and dips, knees tuck; tails swing the old way
Swing through, overshoot: staff whipped forward past level in both hands, chest arched; the first small circle pops at the tip
Settle: staff comes down level; circles open one after another, small to large (4 of 9); tails fling up
Brace (Dodge bar ends): all 9 circles bright, she leans into the staff, legs split; hair and tails blown back
HIT, strike 1 of 14: the arena flashes white; every circle fires, beams with rounded heads; the kick drives her back
Strike 5: she drives the staff left across the room, circles turn with it; weight forward, tails whip to her right
Strike 10: hips swing the staff back to her right and lower, the beams rake the near lanes; tails whip the other way
Release (beams end): she pulls the staff up and back, left hand off it, circles fade; body floats up, tails fly forward
Recover = idle key 0: staff back across the body in both hands, settled

golem.title: Golem: she raises the Stone Golem from the floor, its first slam (rework, jointed rig)

keys.caption: Idle key 0: hovering, staff across the body; no golem yet
Anticipation: staff raised high in her right hand, body turns to her right and leans back, left palm up; tails hang a beat behind
Strike down, overshoot: staff driven at the floor by the golem's spot, she folds over it; a rune ring flares; tails flung up
Settle: staff held on the rune; the floor slabs crack and lift loose round it
Lift: both hands sweep the staff up, she rises with it; the blocks fly in toward the golem's place
Hands high: the body closes round the golem's core, legs and chest set, the head block still in the air
The head block lands: the golem stands; she points the staff at it, left fist at her side
Command: staff raised at the target, she draws up; the golem's fists lock overhead (its rhythm dodge runs)
HIT: she cuts the staff down and the golem slams both fists; shock rings, cracks, flying chips; the arena flashes; tails flung up
Recover = idle key 0 for her; the golem pushes up off the floor, dust settling (it goes on to golem_idle)

rig: jointed (build_boss_mage.py -- jointed): Torso, Head, upper and lower arm and leg per side, 3 segments per twin tail, Staff; the lower arm carries the hand, the lower leg the foot
units: XYZ Euler degrees about each part's joint, relative to its parent; root_offset in model units from the hover height (Z = Roblox Y up)
staff: Staff turns about its grip (its origin); staff_grip_offset moves the grip in the right lower arm's space, model units
effects: sketch labels per key: point[:size] (bright point and cross flare at the staff tip), charge, flash (the arena-wide white flash; look flash = the close views' white-out), cast[:fade] (lightning from the tip along the shaft), strike (bolts all over the room), sustain (the window's strikes, arena view only), embers
